Why Your SQLite Data Disappears After a Redeploy (and How to Stop It)

On most modern hosts your app's filesystem is ephemeral. A redeploy throws away the running instance and builds a fresh one from your code, so anything written to local disk since the last build, including your SQLite .db file, is wiped. The code comes back.

Why Your SQLite Data Disappears After a Redeploy (and How to Stop It)

Quick thread 🧵
On most modern hosts your app's filesystem is ephemeral.
A redeploy throws away the running instance and builds a fresh one from your code, so anything written to local disk since the last build, including your SQLite .db file, is wiped.
The data doesn't, because the data was never in the code.
